_comment: Copy to credentials.json (mode 0600). Normally you never edit this by hand: `login_fetch.py login` (one account) or `login_fetch.py bulk-add` (many accounts) fills it for you, and `sync-9router` issues the bridgeKey values. Two shapes, freely combinable — the bridge serves every profile it finds. SHAPE A (legacy, one account): the top-level profile fields below + a top-level "milq" section. SHAPE B (pool): an "accounts" array whose entries each carry the same profile fields plus "id", "bridgeKey" and their own "milq" section. Only baseURL + apiKey are required per profile; "milq" is ignored by bridge.py and used only by login_fetch.py.

accounts._comment: One pool entry per FreeMilk account (shape B).
